target: positive presynaptic sources to positive ALLN (model eLN); internal excludes union of class:ORN and prefix:ORN_
not_proven: non-ORN is an operational source partition, not graph-theoretic proof that every selected edge is recurrent

metrics.PN_peak: maximum trailing 50ms average with window fully within 1s odor; secondary trailing 10ms peak
metrics.PN_off_1s: mean in OFF +900 to +1000ms (same 100ms observation width as 20s)
metrics.secondary: last500ms during odor; full odor mean; OFF 0-1s and 19-20s means; same metrics for second pulse where available; eLN and ACh/unclear/GABA; ORN transmission raw vs sent

success_interpretation: Report paired peak ratios and residuals without a post-hoc success threshold. Near-zero descriptive threshold <=1Hz; a retained onset peak alone does not establish avoidance of excessive suppression if sustained odor response disappears.
unchanged: original refractory handling, adaptation disabled, first spike amplitude, no OFF-triggered reset, 50ms endTick
parameters: U=.2 and 300ms are the preceding engineering probe, not physiologically calibrated values
